dialogues.jp: 試験終了と共に机に突っ伏す。
dialogues.en: As the exam ended, I fell back into my chair, exhausted.
dialogues.text: As the exam ended, I fell back into my chair, exhausted.

dialogues.speaker: Ren
dialogues.jp:
「時間ですね。後ろから用紙を集めてきて下さ
　い」
dialogues.en:
"Time's up. I'd be going around to collect the answer sheets
now."
dialogues.text:
"Time's up. I'd be going around to collect the answer sheets
now."

dialogues.jp: 恋先生が、落ち着いた声で指示をだしている。
dialogues.en: Ren-sensei calmly told the students what to do.
dialogues.text: Ren-sensei calmly told the students what to do.

dialogues.jp:
周囲では、早くもこの後の話で盛り上がってい
た。
dialogues.en:
All around me, I could hear the voices of students starting
to swell.
dialogues.text:
All around me, I could hear the voices of students starting
to swell.

dialogues.jp: 徐々に、身体に解放感がみなぎってくる。
dialogues.en:
Bit by bit, I could feel my mind, body and soul being
liberated.
dialogues.text:
Bit by bit, I could feel my mind, body and soul being
liberated.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、ＨＲ始めてあげるから、席に着きな〜」
dialogues.en: "Alright, HR is about to begin, return to your desks~"
dialogues.text: "Alright, HR is about to begin, return to your desks~"

dialogues.jp:
テスト用紙を抱えて、暦先生が恋先生と入れ違
いに教室に入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
With test papers in hand, Koyomi-sensei passed by Ren-sensei
in entering the classroom.
dialogues.text:
With test papers in hand, Koyomi-sensei passed by Ren-sensei
in entering the classroom.

dialogues.jp: どうやら隣のクラスの監督をしていたようだ。
dialogues.en: Looks like she was invigilating the class next door.
dialogues.text: Looks like she was invigilating the class next door.

dialogues.jp:
俺はＨＲを受けながら、この後、どこへ行くか
を考えていた……。
dialogues.en: As we had HR, my mind wandered to what I would do after...
dialogues.text: As we had HR, my mind wandered to what I would do after...

dialogues.jp:
無事か有事か別にして、なんとか来ました、こ
の時が。この後のことを、ワイワイと、皆して
想いを馳せていた。
dialogues.en:
With the end of the exams nigh, everyone was in an excited
mood.
dialogues.text:
With the end of the exams nigh, everyone was in an excited
mood.

dialogues.jp: ――そんな、肩の荷の下りた放課後。
